title.narrative: Sustainable electronics management in the Philippines

description.narrative: 183. The project will generate significant socio-economic co-benefits by promoting a more circular and inclusive ICT value chain in the Philippines. At the policy level, strengthened national and local EEE and e-waste regulations will enhance consumer protection and foster more transparent and equitable market conditions. Private sector actors—including ICT importers, retailers, and recyclers—will benefit from clearer regulatory incentives, access to best available techniques (BAT) and best environmental practices (BEP), and expanded opportunities to participate in sustainable and innovative ICT business models.184. By embedding circular economy principles across the ICT lifecycle, the project will contribute to reducing e-waste generation and virgin resource demand through extended product lifespans and increased recovery of valuable materials (“urban mining”). These interventions will mitigate environmental and health risks, particularly for vulnerable communities with high e-waste exposure.185. The project will also promote more inclusive economic participation. Targeted training and capacity-building will enable informal repair and refurbishment workers—many of whom are women—to gain certification and transition into formal employment with improved occupational health and safety standards. This supports decent work, gender equity, and social protection goals. Concurrently, public awareness and behavior change campaigns will empower consumers to adopt more sustainable consumption patterns, including through responsible e-waste management and choices that extend the useful life of ICT products.186. Together, these measures will contribute to more resilient livelihoods, safer working conditions, and enhanced social equity across the ICT value chain, in alignment with national development priorities and the GEM Program’s global objectives.
Note: Disbursement data provided is cumulative and covers disbursement made by the project Agency.
Reduce the environmental and health impacts of ICT equipment and generate inclusive employment by promoting innovative, circular approaches throughout their full lifecycle.
